verdict.rationale: LM Studio is itself an agent/chat application (client) that connects to MCP servers to extend its own models — the evidence (lm-studio-docs-3) shows it consuming MCP servers, not exposing an official MCP server for other agents to connect to. Per the client-vs-server distinction, this axis is out of scope for an agent-type product unless it explicitly runs as an MCP server, which no evidence shows.
